name: MotifBench
description: MotifBench is a bioinformatics benchmark for protein motif scaffolding. It evaluates whether generative or design methods can produce diverse protein scaffolds that preserve a prescribed functional motif geometry, using a standardized pipeline and reproducible structural validation.
evaluation_method: Benchmark-specific protein structure prediction and fixed-backbone sequence design checks; scores motif recovery/preservation, scaffold validity, diversity, and geometric fidelity under the published pipeline.
general_score_metric: motif preservation and scaffold success rate
notes: Introduces a precisely specified benchmark pipeline to improve comparability and reproducibility across motif-scaffolding papers. The benchmark contains 30 problem instances. Typical SOTA values were not provided in the source metadata.
